content.thinking:
Writing joint/skeleton setup code...

I'm defining the hue-pass shading helper that warms highlights and cools shadows based on normal direction, then building out the paint palette for skin, beard, and other surface materials using mottling and grain textures to add natural variation like braid streaks and mustache texture.

Still defining strand colors...

For wood I'll use a grain texture tied to the stock's extrusion axis, steel gets a mottled gray finish, and gold stays mostly flat with occasional shading via hp. I'm keeping the flat-color palette under 64 entries, then moving on to decals and computing the right hand finger positions from W and gz.

Working out wrist and finger joint coordinates...

Still planning remaining pieces: left hand, skirt, belt details, satchel, hat, eye decals, and the mustache geometry using tapered radius sweeps along a defined curve. I think I have enough laid out now to just write the full implementation and iterate from there.

Writing mustache curve points...

Now I'm adding sideburn masses connecting hair to beard and placing the ear geometry on either side of the head.

Shaping ear outline...

I'm placing a small gold torus earring on the lobe of the right ear, then moving on to the jaw, hat brim, and card texture setup, deciding texture generation should happen inside the build function so it's created fresh each time. I'll skip decals on the beard and start writing out the full file.
